label_policy: An expected skill is accepted only when its current public skills.sh page description directly covers the requested operation and artifact. Search rank, install count, and treatment results are not used as relevance evidence.

cases.query: build a Next.js app with App Router and TypeScript
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers React/Next.js App Router, Server Components, TypeScript, and frontend development.

cases.query: query Supabase tables and design RLS policies
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers Supabase queries, schema, authentication, and RLS policies.

cases.query: set up Playwright end-to-end tests with CI
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers Playwright end-to-end setup, example tests, and CI integration.

cases.query: create and format a PowerPoint deck with images and templates
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers PowerPoint creation, formatting, placeholders, images, and templates.

cases.query: create and analyze an Excel spreadsheet with formulas and charts
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers spreadsheet creation/editing, formulas, formatting, analysis, and visualization.

cases.query: generate and fill PDF forms and assemble documents
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers PDF generation, form filling, and document assembly.

cases.query: drive a local Electron app using browser automation and CDP
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers local OpenWork Electron automation through CDP.
Page description explicitly covers comprehensive review of local uncommitted changes.

cases.query: debug a failing program by reproducing isolating and verifying
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers structured debugging, reproduction, isolation, hypotheses, and verification.

cases.query: design a high-converting SaaS landing page
cases.reason: Page description explicitly covers high-converting landing pages for SaaS/apps/services.
